detail.longDescription: i was thinking about why i love # programming & i remembered the first algorithmic problem i ‘solved’ as a kid. i was writing a poker game on a zx81 with 1k of memory. every byte mattered. i had a bug in dealing the cards: sometimes the same card got dealt twice. i coded a number of solutions and was not worried about speed, just memory usage (and correctness). i worked on it for a few hours and learned a lot. i guess my 12-year old self in todays world would just # vibecode it and learn nothing.
